info.title: News Engine
info.description: Continuous news collection, story clustering, tagging, personalised feeds and post briefs. Authenticate with `Authorization: Bearer <ENGINE_API_KEY>`. MCP endpoint: `/mcp`.

get.description: The engine-written 250-500 word account. Generated now if missing (takes ~10-30s) when generate=true.

post.description: Write the digest again from the latest material.

get.description: Original card image for a story: wide 1200x630 or square 1080x1080. Public (no key), cacheable.

post.description: Give stories whose AI tagging gave up a fresh set of attempts (e.g. after topping up API credits).
Dry run: fetch the sitemap and report whether the engine can use it. Saves nothing.
Check the sitemap, create a source for it, and run its first ingest right away.
Run one worker cycle in this process now (the background worker keeps running independently).
